features.description: Spin to reveal winning card combinations.

features.name: Big Ben trigger

features.name: Dice multiplier
features.description: Roll a dice to pick one of six multipliers between 5x and 999x.

review:
A 19th-century London gentlemen's club with card-game reels and a dice-roll bonus. Three Big Ben cards trigger it.

Six multiplier cards worth 5x to 999x are shown, flipped face down, and you roll a dice to pick one – that's your multiplier. It's wildly variable: a 5x and a 999x are very different nights. Very high volatility, a 10,490x max and 96.1% RTP. Love it or hate it, it's tense.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
